guided_sac.bc_term: Initial deterministic actor-gradient norm balancing on a fixed training batch; also discourages action variance
guided_sac.initializer: Matching selected BC actor; fresh optimizers, critics and replay
guided_sac.healthy_terminal: True finite 24h terminal; no timeout bootstrap

selection.order: Highest biased facility relief, tie-break lower RMSE, independently per seed

guided_sac.important_limit: Full fits received 153600 transitions, but the displayed selected checkpoints are early milestones; do not label them final-step models

union.source_identity: Each manifest source_hashes; execution_commit is distinct from later 053b5275 packaging
union.features_and_actions: Same 24D direct-device/full-work interface as BC, no analytic deployment projection
union.objective: Original physical low-level reward, not economic cash

actor_regularizer.direction: KL(current pre-tanh Gaussian || frozen BC Gaussian)
actor_regularizer.states: Equal mixture of 256 fixed-demo and 256 current-replay states; total weight remains 0.1

union.extension_gate: At least one complete four-seed arm: every fit passes all 24 physical/recovery development cases, RMSE <=1.25*own BC and <=0.8*matching Guided; extend both arms
union.extension_execution: Rerun from exact initializer/seed; repeated prefix is compute, not independent replication
union.acceptance_increment_vs_bc: All gates; RMSE <=0.9*own BC; biased relief and 26h cash not below BC beyond roundoff
union.headline_selection: Lowest final-step mean Dev-B RMSE among complete admitted arms, before Final-B; chose union_conditioned
union.adaptation: Dev-B already known and reused, not fresh validation
union.reported_limit: Final-B does not establish an incremental online-RL advantage over BC
